title: Inicializar monorepo y calidad base
acceptance: WHEN pnpm install runs THE SYSTEM SHALL create a reproducible workspace lockfile and resolve the pinned Node/Next toolchain.
WHEN pnpm exec playwright test tests/smoke/admin-http.spec.ts runs THE SYSTEM SHALL start the admin application and receive HTTP 200 from its CarrierFlow home page.
WHEN pnpm --filter @carrierflow/admin typecheck runs THE SYSTEM SHALL exit 0 with strict TypeScript enabled.
do: Create the five listed root/admin/smoke files, including admin dev, build and start scripts. Run `pnpm add -Dw typescript@6.0.3 vitest@4.1.11 @playwright/test@1.62.1 supabase@2.116.0 tailwindcss@4.3.3 shadcn@4.19.0`, then `pnpm --filter @carrierflow/admin add next@16.3.3 react@19.2.8 react-dom@19.2.8 maplibre-gl@6.6.0` for the future operations map; create the HTTP smoke test before Verify.

title: Crear tenant base, schema y RLS
acceptance: WHEN the foundation migration is applied to a local Supabase database THE SYSTEM SHALL create companies, memberships, roles, audit events and RLS policies.
WHEN a member queries a company-scoped row THE SYSTEM SHALL return only rows in that member’s company.
WHEN an unauthenticated or cross-company query is attempted THE SYSTEM SHALL return zero protected rows.
do: Create the listed foundation migration, pgTAP database test/tenant fixture and server env/client files. Before importing them run `pnpm --filter @carrierflow/admin add @supabase/supabase-js@2.112.4 @supabase/ssr@0.12.5`; apply RLS and test it locally.

title: Implementar invitaciones, roles y auditoría
acceptance: WHEN an owner creates an invitation THE SYSTEM SHALL create a pending membership scoped to that owner’s company.
WHEN a driver invokes an administrative mutation THE SYSTEM SHALL return a typed forbidden result and write no business change.
WHEN an authorized mutation succeeds THE SYSTEM SHALL write actor, timestamp, before and after values to the audit log.
do: Create the listed identity migration, pgTAP role test, authorize/result/audit modules. Implement invitation, typed forbidden result and same-transaction audit, then author unit coverage inside the admin test suite.

title: Construir shell administrativo bilingüe
acceptance: WHEN the locale is en or es THE SYSTEM SHALL render the navigation and operational labels in that locale without missing keys.
WHEN the shell is rendered by the accessibility test THE SYSTEM SHALL expose a labelled main landmark and no color-only status control.
WHEN a control is interactive THE SYSTEM SHALL use the shared token set and a 44 px minimum target contract.
do: Create the five listed token, layout, en/es and accessibility-test files. Define the operational light-first tokens, translate navigation/state labels, render a labelled main landmark and test 44 px/non-color contract.

title: Añadir conductor, vehículo y turno
acceptance: WHEN dispatcher creates a driver or vehicle THE SYSTEM SHALL persist it only within the dispatcher’s company.
WHEN a driver starts or ends a shift THE SYSTEM SHALL record on_duty or off_duty with an audit event.
WHEN an inactive driver or vehicle is selected for assignment THE SYSTEM SHALL reject the operation with a typed validation error.
do: Create the listed fleet migration, pgTAP test, fleet service, fleet page and test. Add driver/vehicle CRUD, shift audit, and server validation that rejects inactive assignment.

title: Modelar cargas, evidencia y estados
acceptance: WHEN a load is created THE SYSTEM SHALL store ordered pickup/delivery stops while allowing the pilot form to create exactly one of each.
WHEN an actor attempts delivered before picked_up THE SYSTEM SHALL reject the transition and retain the prior state.
WHEN evidence requirements are configured THE SYSTEM SHALL block delivery until each required non-photo item has valid evidence.
WHEN a problem is reported THE SYSTEM SHALL create an incident without cancelling or bypassing the active load state.
do: Create the listed load migration, pgTAP test, load service, state-machine test and load detail page. Model ordered stops/evidence/incidents, enforce transition order in server and show the read-only load detail.

title: Calcular millas y revisiones de tarifa
acceptance: WHEN a proposed load has a quoted amount and route THE SYSTEM SHALL persist empty miles, loaded miles, total miles and quote_usd divided by total_miles as separate values.
WHEN a driver has an active load THE SYSTEM SHALL calculate the next load’s empty miles from the final planned active stop, not current GPS.
WHEN final stop, driver or assignment changes THE SYSTEM SHALL invalidate the previous estimate, persist a new immutable revision and create a dispatcher notification.
do: Create the listed route-estimate migration, provider interface, service, unit test and routing contract. Persist empty/loaded/total/rate revisions and invalidate/recalculate from active final stop.

title: Crear flujo web de propuesta y asignación
acceptance: WHEN dispatcher enters quote and stops THE SYSTEM SHALL show empty, loaded and total miles separately plus the quoted dollars per total mile.
WHEN dispatcher assigns a load THE SYSTEM SHALL show the assignment as mandatory and expose no driver acceptance or rejection control.
WHEN dispatcher reassigns or cancels a load THE SYSTEM SHALL require authority, retain the event history and refresh the assignee-facing state.
WHEN the operations map route is opened THE SYSTEM SHALL render the authorised current-location surface and a textual fallback without accessing historical locations.
do: Create the listed proposal form, mileage breakdown, dispatch test and operations map page. The map page uses the MapLibre dependency provisioned in Paso 1, shows authorised current location/text fallback, and does not expose raw history; the form exposes no accept/reject control.

title: Inicializar Flutter y lista actual/siguiente
acceptance: WHEN a driver with a valid session opens the app THE SYSTEM SHALL show the current load prominently and a next assigned load without blocking the current workflow.
WHEN the app locale is English or Spanish THE SYSTEM SHALL render driver-facing load labels from locale resources.
WHEN no load is assigned THE SYSTEM SHALL show a safe empty state rather than another driver’s data.
do: Create the listed Flutter pubspec, main, auth gate, load home and widget test. Before any Flutter package usage run each literal command: `cd apps/driver && flutter pub add supabase_flutter:2.17.2`; `cd apps/driver && flutter pub add firebase_core:4.14.0`; `cd apps/driver && flutter pub add firebase_messaging:16.6.0`; `cd apps/driver && flutter pub add drift:2.34.3`; `cd apps/driver && flutter pub add drift_flutter:0.3.1`; `cd apps/driver && flutter pub add connectivity_plus:7.3.1`; `cd apps/driver && flutter pub add url_launcher:6.3.2`; `cd apps/driver && flutter pub add geolocator:14.0.3`; `cd apps/driver && flutter pub add workmanager:0.10.9`; `cd apps/driver && flutter pub add maplibre_gl:0.27.0`. Then show current then next load and localized empty state.

title: Ejecutar carga y evidencia en móvil
acceptance: WHEN a driver advances a load THE SYSTEM SHALL allow only the server-defined ordered transitions.
WHEN configured evidence is incomplete THE SYSTEM SHALL disable delivery and identify the missing required evidence without making photos universally required.
WHEN a driver reports an incident THE SYSTEM SHALL send its category, text, location when available and attachments without cancelling the load.
do: Create the listed Flutter detail/state/evidence files and tests. Call server-defined transitions only, check configurable evidence before delivery and enqueue incident information without cancelling a load.

title: Añadir outbox offline e idempotencia
acceptance: WHEN network is unavailable THE SYSTEM SHALL queue state/evidence mutations locally with a unique client mutation ID.
WHEN the same mutation is replayed after reconnecting THE SYSTEM SHALL return the original server result and create no second delivery or evidence item.
WHEN synchronization fails transiently THE SYSTEM SHALL retain the item, expose retry state and preserve order where dependency requires it.
do: Create the sync migration, outbox, worker and listed Flutter/admin tests. Persist client_mutation_id before send, replay exactly once, preserve dependency ordering and expose retry.

title: Seguimiento, mapa y permisos degradados
acceptance: WHEN an on-duty driver is visible or logged in with an active load THE SYSTEM SHALL record adaptive location samples and show their freshness/accuracy state.
WHEN a load is active and the interface is closed THE SYSTEM SHALL request platform-appropriate background tracking, while showing revoked, approximate or unavailable permission as degraded state.
WHEN the map loads THE SYSTEM SHALL display last authorized current location and load context without streaming unrestricted history.
WHEN a location is retained past policy THE SYSTEM SHALL roll it up or purge it according to the company retention job.
do: Create the five listed location migration, tracking service/permission state/test and Android manifest. Use MapLibre packages already provisioned by Pasos 1 and 9; write current/history/retention data that the existing Paso 8 map surface reads, and model denied/approximate/stale/background states without force-quit promises.

title: Notificar y compartir tracking limitado
acceptance: WHEN a load is assigned, reassigned, changed or cancelled THE SYSTEM SHALL create a minimal notification addressed to the affected device.
WHEN a valid public tracking token is used THE SYSTEM SHALL return only the allowed load status, ETA and configured location data for that single load.
WHEN a public token is expired or revoked THE SYSTEM SHALL return no load data and an HTTP 404 response.
do: Create the listed notification/public-link migration, server service, public route, Flutter push service and test. Send minimal ID payloads and return only scoped/expiring/revocable tracking data.

title: Aplicar entitlements y retención piloto
acceptance: WHEN a company attempts to activate a driver above its pilot plan capacity THE SYSTEM SHALL reject activation without modifying existing drivers.
WHEN a company is in private pilot THE SYSTEM SHALL expose plan capacity and trial state without initiating a payment or checkout request.
WHEN retention jobs run THE SYSTEM SHALL record the policy action and preserve only permitted location/evidence metadata.
do: Create the listed entitlement/retention migration, services, plan page and test. Enforce pilot capacity, show trial without checkout and record privacy retention action.

title: Verificar manifiestos Dokploy y gates de piloto
acceptance: WHEN the production compose configuration is rendered THE SYSTEM SHALL isolate proxy, application, Supabase/data and monitoring on private networks and expose only TLS proxy ports.
WHEN the disposable local restore verifier runs in dry-run mode THE SYSTEM SHALL validate required backup inputs without contacting production or claiming an off-server restore.
WHEN the CI workflow declaration is inspected THE SYSTEM SHALL contain separate typecheck, lint, unit, pgTAP, production build and critical E2E commands.
WHEN tenant-boundary and critical accessibility suites run THE SYSTEM SHALL report no protected cross-company response and no automated violation in labelled critical controls.
verify: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const y=fs.readFileSync('.github/workflows/verify.yml','utf8');for(const x of ['pnpm typecheck','pnpm lint','pnpm test','pnpm exec supabase test db','pnpm --filter @carrierflow/admin build','pnpm exec playwright test'])if(!y.includes(x))process.exit(1)"
pnpm exec playwright test tests/security/tenant-boundary.spec.ts tests/a11y/critical-flows.spec.ts
do: Create the five listed Compose, local restore verifier, CI workflow, security test and a11y test files. Compose exposes only Traefik TLS; the script validates disposable inputs without production contact; CI declares separate typecheck/lint/test/pgTAP/admin-build/Playwright gates.
